rule_or_step_title: Negative Diagnostic Criteria: Major Congenital Heart Disease Exclusion
matching_criterion_description: Complex cyanotic cardiac defects, outflow tract malformations, and truncus arteriosus are absent (0/8) in TAF4 pLoF series; presence suggests an alternate etiology.

rule_or_step_title: Negative Diagnostic Criteria: Structural Gastrointestinal Anomalies Exclusion
matching_criterion_description: Tracheoesophageal fistulae, esophageal atresia, and gut malrotations have not been reported in primary TAF4 probands (0/8).

rule_or_step_title: Negative Diagnostic Criteria: Severe Visceral and Renal Agenesis Exclusion
matching_criterion_description: Renal agenesis, severe cystic renal dysplasia, and diaphragmatic hernias argue decisively against TAF4 haploinsufficiency.

rule_or_step_title: Negative Diagnostic Criteria: Early Progressive Microcephaly / Suture Fusion Exclusion
matching_criterion_description: Premature craniosynostosis is absent in primary cohorts.

rule_or_step_title: Negative Diagnostic Criteria: Catastrophic / Refractory Epileptic Encephalopathy Exclusion
matching_criterion_description: The presence of continuous spike-wave discharges, infantile spasms, or intractable pharmacoresistant epilepsy within the first year of life argues strongly against TAF4 pathology.
